heading: Reports
lead: As soon as practicable after the end of each fiscal year, the Commission shall transmit to the President a report that includes—

tree.text: a detailed statement of the activities and accomplishments of the Commission during the fiscal year; and
any recommendations of the Commission for legislation and administrative actions.
